title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1973-10-29
source: MSR> C> DAT> Circulation> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a high‑energy show with ripping Eyes of the World, monster The Other One and an epic Sugar Magnolia/Casey Jones finale.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for Jerry’s beautiful vocal phrasing and powerful guitar work, especially on Eyes of the World and The Other One. Reviewers note the recording is generally solid, though a touch of distortion appears when Jerry hits high notes. Standout moments include an epic Sugar Magnolia close and a strong Casey Jones, making this show one of the more compelling releases despite a modest set list.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance highlighted by multiple reviewers and overall good soundboard quality, with only minor distortion complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced recording; a few reviewers mention slight distortion on Jerry's high‑note guitar passages.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Even though the set list isn’t deemed spectacular, the flow builds nicely and closes with an epic Sugar Magnolia/Casey Jones pair that lifts the entire show.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for beautiful lyric enunciation and sustained notes; some distortion noted on high‑note guitar parts.
